# MakeHuman bodyparts04 nail meshes (CC0)

The nail plates the body pack carries (`scripts/lib/nailPlates.ts`). Geometry
and binding only (`.mhclo`, `.obj`); their materials and textures are not
used, since the kit draws the plates with its own translucent material.

Pack record (`packs/bodyparts04.json`): `"license": "CC0"`. Page: "License: CC0 - Creative Commons Zero". | 2026-10-09 |
| `mindfront_nails_toes_01` (Mindfront, 2018-02-15) | `mindfront_nails_toes_01.mhclo` (sha256 `d902d75a…aa303604`), `mind_nails_toes_01.obj` (sha256 `55f331d1…f9de950`) | the same pack; page <http://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/1371> | As above. | 2026-10-09 |

The packer judges each with the licence rule's clause B (a community asset
with its captured page; `scripts/lib/licenceRule.ts`), from the files' own
bytes, so a changed file fails the pack.
